# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farm manager  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with sharp angles and without curves. She has dark hair streaked with gray, which she wears twisted in a hard knot pinned aggressively behind her head. She has sallow cheeks and hard, work-worn hands, though her face visibly softened over the years.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v2 c12 P39](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0039)_

## Personality

Marilla possesses a rigid conscience and a pragmatic, sensible nature. Though often stern, critical, and undemonstrative, she has a subtle sense of humor and a deep warmth that mellows her strictness over time. She values neatness, order, and traditional discipline, and she resists showing easy affection or open emotion.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v2 c26 P30](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0030)_

## Goals

- Training Anne to be useful and well-behaved  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>
- Giving Anne a good education to fit her for earning a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with her brother Matthew into her sixties. Deciding to adopt an orphan boy to help Matthew on the farm, they were mistakenly sent a young girl named Anne Shirley. Though initially intent on returning Anne, Marilla was moved to keep her after witnessing Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature. Over the following years, Marilla raised Anne with strict discipline, aiming to form her into a sensible girl while secretly growing deeply attached to her. When Matthew died suddenly, Marilla confessed her deep affection to Anne. As Marilla began suffering severe eye pain that impaired her reading and sewing, she stepped up to manage the farm responsibilities. Following the death of a distant relative, Mary Keith, Marilla took in Mary's orphaned six-year-old twins, Davy and Dora, taking full charge of raising them at Green Gables with Anne's help.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)_

## Background by volume

- Lived at Green Gables for sixty years  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
- Quarreled with her former beau John Blythe and refused to forgive him  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Was stung as a small child when an aunt called her a dark, homely little thing  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Was raised under strict rules where children were seen and not heard  <sub>[v2 c8 P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 c26 P30](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0030)</sub>

## Quotes

> Unromantic fiddlesticks! Anne is a real good plain sensible name. You’ve no need to be ashamed of it.  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>

> I don’t believe in imagining things different from what they really are. When the Lord puts us in certain circumstances He doesn’t mean for us to imagine them away.  <sub>[v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019)</sub>

> I love you as dear as if you were my own flesh and blood and you’ve been my joy and comfort ever since you came to Green Gables.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>

> We had a quarrel. I wouldn’t forgive him when he asked me to. I meant to, after awhile—but I was sulky and angry and I wanted to punish him first. He never came back—the Blythes were all mighty independent. But I always felt—rather sorry. I’ve always kind of wished I’d forgiven him when I had the chance.  <sub>[v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>

> I’ve lived here for sixty years and I’ve never been on the pond yet.  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
